tables.name: boards
tables.description: One board per user for the MVP; future-ready for multi-board support.

tables.name: columns
tables.description: Board columns. Titles are editable; the five column ids are fixed. Primary key is (board_id, id) so each board owns its ids.

tables.name: cards
tables.description: Kanban cards attached to a board column. Primary key is (board_id, id).

notes: The MVP uses a single board per user, but the schema is modeled to allow future multi-board and multi-user expansion.
Ids are text (the UI generates card ids). Columns and cards are keyed per board, so two boards can both have 'card-1' or 'col-backlog'.
Column and card positions are stored as integers so drag-and-drop ordering is deterministic. Card order within a column is read by sorting on position.
password_hash holds a SHA-256 of the MVP password; sign-in itself is checked in the browser for the MVP.
SQLite is the database engine because the app runs locally and the project scope is intentionally small.
